lines.text: Thanks for talking with us. What do you teach?
I teach science to twelve year olds, about thirty kids per class.
The hardest part is grading lab reports, it takes my whole Sunday.
I use a spreadsheet for marks but it never matches the school system.
I wish I could give quick voice feedback instead of writing the same comment thirty times.
My favorite tool is anything that works on my phone during break.
Great. Tom will send Priya a prototype of voice feedback next week.

summary: Priya teaches science and spends her Sunday grading lab reports.
She wishes she could give quick voice feedback and needs tools that work on her phone.
actions: Tom: send Priya a prototype of voice feedback
